adjudication.rationale: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb several new tests hardcode `id: 1` / `group_id: 1` to represent an automatic group (e.g. `.update` "ignore name change on automatic group", `.add_members` "cannot add members to automatic groups", `.remove_member` "cannot remove members from automatic groups"). The diff does not fabricate an automatic group with that id in these examples, so the tests implicitly depend on seeded/fixture state (e.g. a built-in automatic group having id 1). This makes the tests brittle to seed/schema/order changes; other tests in the file correctly use `Fabricate(:group, automatic: true)`.
